notes: Public agency-policy research only; not authorization for commercial footage reuse. No requester data or outcomes.

records.name: Anchorage Police Department
records.finding: Police records including video use online public records center; one case/incident number per request. A nonrefundable administrative filing fee applies. Official site has an account-creation tutorial, but a mandatory initial login was not verified.
records.cost: Nonrefundable filing fee; video-specific total not established.
records.access: Online public records center; submit one numbered incident per request. Account step requires live verification.
records.recommendation: Open official APD records center, split cases into separate requests, and display fee warning.

records.name: Buckeye Police Department
records.finding: Agency GovQA records portal supports BWC requests. Starting March 26, 2026 public-records video gets medium blur applied to full video; audio redactions unchanged. Agency provides cost estimate before user pays via portal. Arizona commercial-purpose rules still require manual review.
records.cost: Quote required before payment; current pricing schedule must be checked on official site.
records.access: Police GovQA portal; initial account requirements unverified.
records.recommendation: Warn about full-video medium blur and commercial-purpose disclosure, require cost approval before proceeding.

records.name: Clallam County Sheriff's Office
records.finding: Official page accepts online and telephone requests and requires specific identifying details for BWC. First $10 of request costs may be waived, but video redaction can incur actual-time fees; free-video exemptions apply to limited types of requesters.
records.cost: Waives total charges up to $10; otherwise video redaction actual-time fees may apply.
records.access: Online or phone request; name, case number, date/location, or officer identifiers needed.
records.recommendation: Do not treat as universally free; avoid auto-claiming subject/attorney fee exemptions.

records.name: Douglas County Sheriff's Office
records.finding: Official BWC PDF may be submitted by email, writing, fax or in person. One case number per form; all forms signed. Video email delivery uses a time-limited Evidence.com link that requires creation of an account. Filing does not require signing into a FOIA portal.
records.cost: $1 per released/redacted video; storage medium cost if physical media is used.
records.access: Email/physical signed request form; delivered Evidence.com link requires login and expires seven days after sending.
records.recommendation: Prepare one signed request per case for user review; add a seven-day delivery-link reminder. Do not save credentials.

records.name: Frederick County Sheriff
records.finding: Official BWC request instructions and a tiered video fee schedule; footage release and commercial reuse not guaranteed.
records.cost: $20 under 10 min, $30 under 20 min, $40 plus $1/min beyond 20 min; possible redaction charges

records.name: Jefferson County Sheriff's Office
records.finding: Sheriff says BWC requests go through NextRequest, with date/time/location and case number if available. Its guidance estimates 10–15 business days for BWC review and redaction but complex cases may take longer. Colorado commercial-solicitation certifications remain a separate issue.
records.cost: Possible redaction charges; video total not verified.
records.access: NextRequest request route; normal account-free first-request behavior should be tested at this specific agency.
records.recommendation: Prepopulate incident metadata, preserve Colorado manual legal-review requirement, and show estimated processing window without guarantee.

records.name: Marion County Sheriff
records.finding: Official records information describes separate video review and redaction labor charges. Monetized reuse not cleared.

records.name: Metro Nashville Police Department
records.finding: Official BWC policy lists seven-year retention for arrest footage and six years for vehicle pursuits/use-of-force. Video disclosure remains subject to law, case-specific exemptions, and Tennessee requester eligibility.
records.access: Public records request form; legal-access eligibility requires manual review.
records.recommendation: Surface incident-category retention periods but keep Tennessee eligibility/manual review gate; do not infer footage exists.

records.name: Miami-Dade Sheriff's Office
records.finding: GovQA portal exposes public records and Media Request categories separately. Bodycam request processing provides an estimate, then deposit/payment, redaction and final cost notice. Media category should not be automatically selected without confirming the requester's actual status.
records.cost: Variable; advance estimate and deposit/payment required for bodycam processing.
records.access: GovQA portal category selection plus potential user account; status and delivery through records system.
records.recommendation: Use the appropriate category, seek fee quote and explicit user approval, avoid automatic payment.

records.name: Ohio State Highway Patrol
records.finding: Special notarized video fee exemption is limited to qualifying victims and representatives. Do not claim exemption without eligibility; manual cost review required.
records.cost: Ohio law permits up to $75 per hour of video produced, maximum $750

records.name: Pierce County Sheriff's Department
records.finding: Published sheriff records fee schedule states BWC or dashcam redaction is billed by minute of redaction work. Agency may quote fees, and records need to be claimed/paid after notification.
records.cost: $0.63 per minute of redaction time; possible additional copying charges.
records.access: Sheriff public-records request system; fee due before release.
records.recommendation: Request a fee estimate and set reminders for agency response/claim periods; no automatic payment.

records.name: Portland Police Bureau
records.finding: BWC public-records requests may require payment and redaction; published minimum retention is not a release guarantee.
records.cost: Paid, quote depends on recording and redaction

records.name: St. Lucie County Sheriff
records.finding: Official bodycam records page lists a nonrefundable deposit and hourly labor; final price and disclosure remain case specific.
